perItemFindings.one_line: `Causalean.ML.IsRKHS` only supplies `f x = ⟪f, representer x⟫`; it provides neither a kernel-mean embedding nor a unit-norm feature-map concentration interface, so it cannot itself realize the stated Gaussian-MMD/empirical-mean reuse.
